mostWorthwhile.text: Building the capillary bed was most worthwhile because its thin walls were connected clearly to exchange between blood and the fluid around cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building and then branching the arterial vessels felt predictable; the descriptions showed their structure but gave little explanation of how the walls handle pressure.

surprise.text: The final explanation clarified the direction of blood flow and the role of valves in many limb veins, which had not been explained when I added them.

arbitrary.text: No combination felt arbitrary: the parts had recognizable roles in a route through tissues. The later choices were largely forced, though.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see how the vessel network connects to the rest of the body, although I would hope for more explanations alongside the predictable construction steps.
